name: Return to the Bulwark
summary: Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark asks you to bring her a filled bottle from Writhing Haunt. The delivery links the haunt to the outpost in the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: A Bottle for Vandis
sections.body: The filled bottle is meant for Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark. You carry it from Writhing Haunt to the outpost in the Western Plaguelands, where Vandis is waiting for it.

faq.answer: Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark asks you to bring her the filled Writhing Haunt bottle.

faq.q: Where do I take the filled bottle?
faq.answer: Bring the filled Writhing Haunt bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark in the Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: Where does the bottle come from?
faq.answer: The bottle is from Writhing Haunt.

attribution: In-game quest text: Return to the Bulwark
